research_question: Can train-only ACF AutoCon pretraining of a strictly channel-count agnostic, one-Mamba-block MambaTSv3 patch encoder improve 10% Traffic adaptation beyond the same averaged source-core initialization?
architecture: The deployed target uses one MambaTSv3 Mamba block per shared patch sequence, batched over channels. It bypasses channel embeddings and cross-variable context, so parameter shapes and per-channel encoded states are invariant to sensor count and channel order. It updates only patch_embedding, patch_position_embedding, encoder, final_norm, and repr_* parameters. The masked-patch decoder and mask token are training-only and excluded from transfer.
data_boundary: Every source uses only its chronological 60% training prefix. Traffic uses only 10% of its chronological training prefix for adaptation and its existing validation block for selection. No target test row, target test metric, or target test prediction is opened.

pretraining_controls.initial_average: Equal average of four PEMS H12 AutoCon MambaTSv3 source cores before self-supervision.

comparison_contract.secondary_contrast: all historical reconstruction arms remain negative controls
comparison_contract.promotion_rule: A result may only enter a new independent Weather gate if AutoCon improves reconstruction-only and initial_average on Traffic development. No target-specific retuning follows a failed contrast.
